hard_fail: conflicting route ownership with attempted write
publication_volume_authority: data/cadence/policy.json (new_pages_per_week) is the single source of truth for publishing rate. _content_release_contract.json holds the per-day safety cap, which can only lower it. Nothing here may restate either number.
lane_semantics: A lane grants ADMISSION requirements, never publication volume. This file previously carried global_caps.new_pages_per_run=50, route_mutations_per_day=300 and per-lane max_new_pages_per_run of 30/15/5. No publisher, workflow or validator ever read any of them - they were a governance file governing nothing - and after the cadence throttle they contradicted the contract by up to 25x. The repo's own doctrine already forbids per-run publication caps (validate_authority_scale.mjs: strategy_still_declares_per_run_publication_caps), because budget is a shared daily/weekly allowance, not a per-run quota.
